title: Actual good ai pixel art tools and workflows?
author: IamLeperMessiah
selftext:
I am working on a 2d platformer and I suck at pixel art. I  
  
I can generate some good characters etc but the animation part eludes me. I have wasted so many credits on some of these sites trying to get my character to do a forward roll dodge animation or other such thing only to just end up really frustrated trying to make it work. 

What workflows have you found that work well from generating a character to animating it? This is the last part of my puzzle as I have the game working in greybox and my vertical slice is done except for the art.

I have specific timings and thats one of the other issues. I-Frames etc impact the animation lengths and a lot of times the tools I find dont allow me to specify the animation length etc.

comments.author: witmann_pl
comments.body: I got pretty good results generating my character with ChatGPT, then passing the image with the character standing sideways to Grok Imagine 1.5 and prompting it to generate a video with the action I want. Sometimes a few attempts were needed but in the end I got a set of usable animations which I then extracted single frames from, fixed with Pixel Snapper ( [https://www.spritefusion.com/pixel-snapper](https://www.spritefusion.com/pixel-snapper) ) and used as sprite frames.

replies.author: IamLeperMessiah
replies.body: I will give that a shot as well.

comments.author: KhaosPT
comments.body: If you have just one character, you might be able to generate the char in different angles and then hook it up to a tool like spine or dragon bones. I myself have given up on generating the animation with video. It works semi okay some times, but one time it took me almost a week of attempts to get a waking animation correct because it kept changing the character. In the end I generated a spine inspired tool that auto splits my characters and I design all my animations there. Works for me and now I just generate each character once and the rig animates it correctly. Also unblocked me on changing weapons etc.

replies.author: IamLeperMessiah
replies.body: yeah the hallucinations are causing me a lot of frustrations. Sword switches hands or shield just goes away...

comments.author: zenmatrix83
comments.body: It’s not perfect but ChatGPT and others can generate sprite sheets that you can try , they might slightly be different but it’s been ok
